note: First election of the rural district council (Lurgan Poor Law Union: electoral divisions in Counties Armagh, Down and Antrim), 6 April 1899. No party labels printed. Returned unopposed. James Campbell: no party label printed in 1899, and the report of the election names no party for him: Dublin Daily Nation, 28 Feb 1899, p. 7 ("Meeting at Derrytrasna"): candidates chosen by the Catholic voters of Montiaghs DED for the rural district council, with Dr Magennis for the county council. The label Nationalist shown before 7 Nov 2026 was read into that description (described as candidates of the Catholic voters; the Lurgan Times calls the same campaign Nationalist). Andrew McCaughey: no party label printed in 1899, and the report of the election names no party for him: Dublin Daily Nation, 28 Feb 1899, p. 7 ("Meeting at Derrytrasna"): candidates chosen by the Catholic voters of Montiaghs DED for the rural district council, with Dr Magennis for the county council. The label Nationalist shown before 7 Nov 2026 was read into that description (described as candidates of the Catholic voters; the Lurgan Times calls the same campaign Nationalist).
